event.name: 2026 Rasuwa–Bhote Koshi flash flood
event.cause_status: A rock–ice/glacial collapse on the Nepal side of Langtang Lirung is the leading assessment. It generated a cross-border debris-flow/flood; causal and field details remain under review.
event.evidence_status: The contract-correct 27-window OLMoEarth screening is complete. Event change is below the single matched-location ordinary transition in almost every token; the result prioritizes review but does not establish damage or a calibrated anomaly.

incident_updates.title: Langtang Lirung rock–ice collapse
incident_updates.summary: USGS reclassified the initial earthquake-like signal as an M5.2-equivalent landslide/glacial-collapse signal at zero depth; the source is on the Nepal side of Langtang Lirung.

incident_updates.title: Second seismic landslide signal
incident_updates.summary: A second M4.2-equivalent signal followed roughly three hours later on 26 Aug. It is not evidence of a separate 27 Aug Tibet landslide.

incident_updates.title: Debris-dammed lake reported
incident_updates.summary: Authorities reported a new upstream barrier lake created in the aftermath of the collapse; its exact public coordinates remained unresolved.

incident_updates.title: Barrier lake draining
incident_updates.summary: Chinese authorities reported the lake was draining and its level had fallen, while monitoring for secondary hazards continued.
incident_updates.source: State Council of the People's Republic of China

points.name: Langtang Lirung collapse source
points.place: North flank of Langtang Lirung, Rasuwa, Nepal (satellite/seismic estimate)
points.source: USGS + China Geological Survey + satellite interpretation
points.story: The rock–ice collapse began on the Nepal side of Langtang Lirung. This red marker is the best public source-search estimate—not a surveyed release polygon. It is the event origin; A and B are downstream impact/checkpoint windows.
points.story_ko: 붕괴는 네팔 영내 랑탕 리룽에서 시작됐다. 빨간 점은 공개된 자료로 추정한 발원 지점으로, 현장에서 실측해 확정하지는 않았다. 여기서 시작된 흐름이 아래로 내려가 A와 B에 닿았다.

points.name: Barrier lake (reported)
points.place: Lhende Khola upstream corridor, Gyirong County, Tibet (provisional)
points.source: NDRRMA report + AP and Chinese government updates; exact coordinates unpublished
points.story: A reported debris-dammed lake formed during the aftermath. Its public footprint is unresolved, so this purple marker is an approximate search zone—not a second collapse origin or a simulated lake boundary. A model-free search of the ±5 km zone found the 27 Aug optical scene 85% cloud, so new water cannot be confirmed; same-orbit Sentinel-1 (23 Jul·4 Aug·16 Aug median vs 28 Aug) shows ≥3 dB backscatter drops clustered in the Lhende valley south-west of the source (largest 0.38 km² at 85.507E 28.251N). Radar alone cannot tell standing water from wet debris, so these are search targets, not a lake outline.
points.story_ko: 흘러내린 토사와 돌에 물길이 막히면서 호수가 생겼다는 보고가 뒤따랐다. 공개된 위치 자료가 없어 보라색 점은 대략적인 수색 범위로 볼 수 있다.

points.name: Rasuwagadhi impact AOI
points.place: Pasang Lhamu Highway, Rasuwagadhi, Rasuwa, Nepal
points.source: user coordinate + OSM Nominatim reverse lookup; USGS event assessment
points.story: The principal before/after inspection window at the Nepal–China crossing. A is not the collapse origin: it is where the upstream cascade reached infrastructure and where the current satellite time series is centered.
points.story_ko: 네팔과 중국 국경 지역을 사건 전후로 비교한 구역이다. 상류에서 시작된 산사태와 홍수가 기반시설에 닿은 지점으로, 이번 관측에서 피해가 가장 큰 곳으로 보인다.

points.name: Gyirong border checkpoint
points.source: user coordinate + OSM Nominatim reverse lookup; USGS event assessment
points.story: The cross-border checkpoint beside the impact AOI. It anchors human-exposure review without treating every bright or dark satellite pixel as confirmed infrastructure damage.
points.story_ko: 피해 관찰 구역 바로 옆에 있는 국경 검문소다. 사진에서 밝거나 어둡게 나온 부분을 곧바로 피해라고 읽는 대신, 사람과 시설이 얼마나 노출됐는지 가늠하는 기준점으로 삼았다.

points.name: Trishuli Bazar / Bidur reach
points.place: Trishuli Bazar reach, Bidur, Nuwakot, Nepal
points.source: USGS public event map; OSM river reach
points.story: A real downstream Sentinel-2 before/after window on MGRS tile 45RUL. The pair closes the visual chain from source to river response; it is observation evidence, not a damage label. Bidur is now included in the separate contract-correct 27-window OLMo screen.
points.story_ko: 하류를 찍은 센티넬-2 사진을 사건 전후로 비교한 구역이다. 발원지부터 하천의 변화까지 하나로 이어 볼 수 있게 해준다.

points.name: Galchhi reach-search endpoint
points.place: Trishuli corridor near Galchhi, Dhading, Nepal
points.source: USGS preliminary ~100 km travel assessment + OSM river trace
points.story: The mapped inspection corridor currently ends here, 73.7 river-km below Rasuwagadhi. USGS reports nearly 100 km of total travel from the source, but has not published a final terminal deposit polygon. G is the end of this trace—not proof that the flood or debris stopped here. In the AI screen the signal fades toward G: 6.7% of 40 m cells flagged in the Galchhi window against 25% at Dalphedi, and 3–4% two windows upstream — close to the 3.6% of the no-event control. But the 27 Aug image here is hazy, so 'little change' is a weak reading, not evidence that nothing happened.
points.story_ko: 지도에 그린 추적선은 라수와가디에서 하천을 따라 73.7km 내려온 이 지점에서 멈춘다. 미국 지질조사국은 발원지부터 약 100km를 흘러갔다고 잠정 보고했지만, 토사가 최종적으로 어디에 쌓였는지는 아직 공개하지 않았다. 실제 흐름은 이 지점보다 더 내려갔을 가능성이 크다.

points.name: Control window · no event (Tadi Khola)
points.place: Tadi Khola valley, Nuwakot (east of the corridor), Nepal
points.source: control window chosen by 27 Aug observability among 4 candidates (Melamchi, Tadi, Ankhu, Rishing)

control_stats.correction_2026_09_02: 34.8% of this window lies outside the Sentinel-2 scene (zero-filled, Δ≈0.045); fractions are now computed over in-scene tokens only (n=1,989). Earlier 3.6%/1.3% were diluted.

points.story: A deliberately quiet valley ~20 km east of the flood corridor with no reported event. On 27 Aug it is 84% cloud-free, and the AI change score equals its ordinary fortnight (0.129 vs 0.125; 6.2% candidate tokens under the corridor scan threshold, 2.3% under the pooled three-pair threshold, vs 25% / 13.3% at the top corridor window). This is what 'no change' looks like under the same recipe. Correction 2026-09-02: 35% of this window falls outside the satellite scene and was zero-filled; the fractions are computed over in-scene tokens only (earlier 3.6% / 1.3% were diluted by the empty area).

input_contract.sentinel1: RTC VV/VH linear intensity -> Sentinel1ToDecibels -> OlmoEarthNormalize

input_contract.spatial: 2.56 km windows; 64x64 spatial tokens; 768-d per token

corridor_sealed.claim: contract-correct, matched-location candidate-change screening; not damage, cause, extent, probability, or calibrated anomaly
limitations: Only one matched-location ordinary transition is available per window.
The local p99 is therefore a screening reference, not a population percentile.
No Nepal event polygon or field label was used to validate the ranking.
OLMoEarth embeddings fuse S1 and S2; this report does not attribute a score to one sensor.
corridor_sealed.visual_legend: colour bands = relative embedding change, smoothed for display only (native 40 m tokens; never interpolated across cloud); bright line = the pooled ordinary-transition p99 threshold; transparent = ordinary or unobserved

input_contract_audit.defect: Sentinel-1 RTC COGs contained linear intensity, while the previous model configuration applied OlmoEarthNormalize without Sentinel1ToDecibels.
input_contract_audit.official_contract: Planetary Computer Sentinel-1 intensity must pass Sentinel1ToDecibels before OlmoEarthNormalize.
input_contract_audit.preservation: Old 27-window embedding rasters were moved to layers/embeddings_linear_s1 and old manifests/seals to superseded_linear_s1 on the compute host; they were not deleted.
input_contract_audit.claim_boundary: Only the corrected 27-window report may be used for current S1+S2 OLMoEarth claims. The five-anchor reports remain provenance records but are not valid evidence until rerun under the corrected contract.

five_anchor_rerun.result: all five anchors not detected (naive and matched token-level); corridor: no candidate under own 1-period threshold; borrowed-threshold ranking top = Devighat, Bidur, Rasuwagadhi

corridor_contract.next_step: Acquire at least 20 matched ordinary transitions or an independent event polygon before calibrated detection claims.
corridor_contract.claim_boundary: Screening only. No corridor damage, reach, calibrated anomaly, or probability claim exists without more ordinary transitions and independent labels.
